text.style: font-size:25px;font-weight:600;font-family:'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif;line-height:1.2

text.tspan: Total disease burden by age, measured in Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALYs) from all causes.
DALYs measure the total burden of disease – both from years of life lost due to premature death and years lived
with a disability. One DALY equals one lost year of healthy life.
Data source: IHME, Global Burden of Disease (2025)
